options.name: add_host
options.description: Add a host to the /etc/hosts file shared between all containers in the pod.

options.name: blkio_weight
options.description: Block IO relative weight. The weight is a value between 10 and 1000. This option is not supported on cgroups V1 rootless systems.

options.name: blkio_weight_device
options.description: Block IO relative device weight.

options.name: cgroup_parent
options.description: Path to cgroups under which the cgroup for the pod will be created. If the path is not absolute, he path is considered to be relative to the cgroups path of the init process. Cgroups will be created if they do not already exist.

options.name: cpu_shares
options.description: CPU shares (relative weight).

options.name: cpus
options.description: Set the total number of CPUs delegated to the pod. Default is 0.000 which indicates that there is no limit on computation power.

options.name: cpuset_cpus
options.description: Limit the CPUs to support execution. First CPU is numbered 0. Unlike `cpus` this is of type string and parsed as a list of numbers. Format is 0-3,0,1

options.name: cpuset_mems
options.description: Memory nodes in which to allow execution (0-3, 0,1). Only effective on NUMA systems.

options.name: debug
options.description: Return additional information which can be helpful for investigations.

options.name: device
options.description: Add a host device to the pod. Optional permissions parameter can be used to specify device permissions. It is a combination of r for read, w for write, and m for mknod(2)

options.name: device_read_bps
options.description: Limit read rate (bytes per second) from a device (e.g. device-read-bps=/dev/sda:1mb)

options.name: device_write_bps
options.description: Limit write rate (in bytes per second) to a device.

options.name: dns
options.description: Set custom DNS servers in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod. A special option, "none" is allowed which disables creation of /etc/resolv.conf for the pod.

options.name: dns_opt
options.description: Set custom DNS options in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod.

options.name: dns_search
options.description: Set custom DNS search domains in the /etc/resolv.conf file that will be shared between all containers in the pod.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: exit_policy
options.description: Set the exit policy of the pod when the last container exits. Supported policies are stop and continue

options.name: generate_systemd
options.description: Generate systemd unit file for container.

options.name: gidmap
options.description: GID map for the user namespace. Using this flag will run the container with user namespace enabled. It conflicts with the `userns` and `subgidname` flags.

options.name: gpus
options.description: GPU devices to add to the container ('all' to pass all GPUs).

options.name: hostname
options.description: Set a hostname to the pod

options.name: infra
options.description: Create an infra container and associate it with the pod. An infra container is a lightweight container used to coordinate the shared kernel namespace of a pod. Default is true.

options.name: infra_command
options.description: The command that will be run to start the infra container. Default is "/pause".

options.name: infra_conmon_pidfile
options.description: Write the pid of the infra container's conmon process to a file. As conmon runs in a separate process than Podman, this is necessary when using systemd to manage Podman containers and pods.

options.name: infra_image
options.description: The image that will be created for the infra container. Default is "k8s.gcr.io/pause:3.1".

options.name: infra_name
options.description: The name that will be used for the pod's infra container.

options.name: ip
options.description: Set a static IP for the pod's shared network.

options.name: ip6
options.description: Set a static IPv6 for the pod's shared network.

options.name: label
options.description: Add metadata to a pod, pass dictionary of label keys and values.

options.name: label_file
options.description: Read in a line delimited file of labels.

options.name: mac_address
options.description: Set a static MAC address for the pod's shared network.

options.name: memory
options.description: Set memory limit. A unit can be b (bytes), k (kibibytes), m (mebibytes), or g (gibibytes).

options.name: memory_swap
options.description: Set limit value equal to memory plus swap. A unit can be b (bytes), k (kibibytes), m (mebibytes), or g (gibibytes).

options.name: name
options.description: Assign a name to the pod.

options.name: network
options.description: Set network mode for the pod. Supported values are bridge (the default), host (do not create a network namespace, all containers in the pod will use the host's network), or a list of names of CNI networks to join.

options.name: network_alias
options.description: Add a network-scoped alias for the pod, setting the alias for all networks that the pod joins. To set a name only for a specific network, use the alias option as described under the -`network` option. Network aliases work only with the bridge networking mode. This option can be specified multiple times.

options.name: no_hosts
options.description: Disable creation of /etc/hosts for the pod.

options.name: pid
options.description: Set the PID mode for the pod. The default is to create a private PID namespace for the pod. Requires the PID namespace to be shared via `share` option.

options.name: pod_id_file
options.description: Write the pod ID to the file.

options.name: publish
options.description: Publish a port or range of ports from the pod to the host.

options.name: quadlet_dir
options.description: Path to the directory to write quadlet file in. By default, it will be set as C(/etc/containers/systemd/) for root user, C(~/.config/containers/systemd/) for non-root users.

options.name: quadlet_file_mode
options.description: The permissions of the quadlet file. The O(quadlet_file_mode) can be specified as octal numbers or as a symbolic mode (for example, V(u+rwx) or V(u=rw,g=r,o=r)). For octal numbers format, you must either add a leading zero so that Ansible's YAML parser knows it is an octal number (like V(0644) or V(01777)) or quote it (like V('644') or V('1777')) so Ansible receives a string and can do its own conversion from string into number. Giving Ansible a number without following one of these rules will e

options.name: quadlet_filename
options.description: Name of quadlet file to write. By default it takes I(name) value.

options.name: quadlet_options
options.description: Options for the quadlet file. Provide missing in usual container args options as a list of lines to add.

options.name: recreate
options.description: Use with present and started states to force the re-creation of an existing pod.

options.name: restart_policy
options.description: Restart policy to follow when containers exit.

options.name: security_opt
options.description: Security options for the pod.

options.name: share
options.description: A comma delimited list of kernel namespaces to share. If none or "" is specified, no namespaces will be shared. The namespaces to choose from are ipc, net, pid, user, uts.

options.name: share_parent
options.description: This boolean determines whether or not all containers entering the pod use the pod as their cgroup parent. The default value of this option in Podman is true.

options.name: shm_size
options.description: Set the size of the /dev/shm shared memory space. A unit can be b (bytes), k (kibibytes), m (mebibytes), or g (gibibytes). If the unit is omitted, the system uses bytes. If the size is omitted, the default is 64m. When size is 0, there is no limit on the amount of memory used for IPC by the pod.

options.name: shm_size_systemd
options.description: Size of systemd-specific tmpfs mounts such as /run, /run/lock, /var/log/journal and /tmp. A unit can be b (bytes), k (kibibytes), m (mebibytes), or g (gibibytes). If the unit is omitted, the system uses bytes. If the size is omitted, the default is 64m. When size is 0, the usage is limited to 50 percents of the host's available memory.

options.name: state
options.description: This variable is set for state

options.name: subgidname
options.description: Name for GID map from the /etc/subgid file. Using this flag will run the container with user namespace enabled. This flag conflicts with `userns` and `gidmap`.

options.name: subuidname
options.description: Name for UID map from the /etc/subuid file. Using this flag will run the container with user namespace enabled. This flag conflicts with `userns` and `uidmap`.

options.name: sysctl
options.description: Set kernel parameters for the pod.

options.name: uidmap
options.description: Run the container in a new user namespace using the supplied mapping. This option conflicts with the `userns` and `subuidname` options. This option provides a way to map host UIDs to container UIDs. It can be passed several times to map different ranges.

options.name: userns
options.description: Set the user namespace mode for all the containers in a pod. It defaults to the PODMAN_USERNS environment variable. An empty value ("") means user namespaces are disabled.

options.name: uts
options.description: Set the UTS namespace mode for the pod.

options.name: volume
options.description: Create a bind mount.

options.name: volumes_from
options.description: Mount volumes from the specified container.
